title: Trump is trying to control the news. Farage is desperate to follow him
gist: Rusbridger argues Trump and Farage are following the 'clever autocrat' playbook of media capture via friendly owners, citing the Ellisons now owning both CBS and CNN, White House press bans, Trump TV and a crypto-funded Reform YouTube channel. He warns UK media is concentrating in foreign or billionaire hands and that a Reform government would gut the BBC, already down 37% in real-terms funding since 2010.

insights.claim: The Ellison family, who backed Trump, now own both CBS and CNN; Larry Ellison gave about $45m to help re-elect Trump in 2024.
insights.speaker: Alan Rusbridger
insights.so_what: Consolidation of US news under Trump-aligned ownership; political alignment shapes M&A approvals.
